fullHistory.content: change the floor size of unitree g1 robot model
create a file for 6 wheel robot

I've created a 6-wheel robot model in `assets/scenes/six_wheel_robot.xml`. The model features:

- Six wheels arranged in three rows (front, middle, rear) on each side
- A central chassis with a center of mass site
- Independent hinge joints for each wheel with motor actuators
- A grid-pattern floor

The XML is valid and ready to use. To run it in Roba Studio, select "six_wheel_robot" from the scene dropdown.
